cases.title: The learner stops after a try that moved the layer: recorded partial, plain words, no method or numbers

rubric.reason: In Turn 4, record_lesson stores result "partial" with demo_used false (no demo ran; Needle was only offered), and the summary has no numbers, method or motive. The mentor also says "I've noted that for next time."

Every name the mentor uses appears in the tool results: Door, Needle (watch_offer), Door's pivot "at its center" (place_now), "middle of its left edge" (middle-left), and Door moving "to the right" (item2 direction "right").
